title: cuicui.note_corrections
description: Syllable notes set by ear for one syllable bank (WP-R5, study TUNE1, decision D-032). `python -m cuicui.bank --corrections <file>` applies them: a corrected syllable's note becomes `note_cents` under every note rule; a 'no clear note' syllable is flagged and never starts a key press. Syllables are matched by their annotation segment; the label must agree.

bank.description: the bank these corrections belong to (its name)

reference_rule.description: the rule the listener started from (the slider's zero)

reference_cents.description: the note every syllable was placed on while listening

segment.description: index of the syllable's segment in the annotation file

note_cents.description: the note heard, MIDI cents (6900 = A4), at the syllable's own pitch

move_cents.description: how far the listener moved it from the reference rule's placement

rule_e_cents.description: the reference rule's note when the listener set it
